mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) has mild antiplatelet and anticoagulant properties that may potentiate selegiline's effect on bleeding risk, and both substances may have additive effects on platelet function and potentially CNS dopaminergic activity.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding; counsel patient on avoiding excessive turmeric supplementation and to report unusual bruising, bleeding, or neurological changes while on selegiline.
